updates.content:
Title: Admins may encounter reporting delays across multiple Microsoft 365 admin centers and Viva Insights

User impact: Admins may encounter reporting delays across multiple Microsoft 365 admin centers and Viva Insights.

More info: Affected reports include, but aren't limited to:

- Copilot Usage report in Microsoft 365 admin center
- Copilot Chat Usage report in Microsoft 365 admin center
- Copilot Readiness reports in Microsoft 365 admin center and Viva Insights
- Copilot Adoption report in Viva Insights
- Microsoft 365 Apps and Active users reports in Microsoft 365 admin center
- Teams App reports in Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft Teams admin center

Current status: Our monitoring has identified an increase report generation delays and our investigation has identified that an upstream component that facilitates report data access and generation isn't responding as expected, resulting in impact. We're in the process of identifying the underlying cause of impact and develop a remediation strategy.

Scope of impact: Any admin expecting reports from the affected scenarios as outlined in the More info section may be affected. 

Start time: Friday, August 21, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Next update by: Monday, August 24, 2026, at 6:30 PM UTC
